# Muse Skills + Jev

⚠️ Security warning from Skill Harbor: we detected a potentially dangerous pattern — this build installs via `curl | bash`, which runs remote code on your machine without review. Only install if you have read the code yourself. Use at your own risk.

A 23-skill library plus the "Jev" decision layer for Muse agents: before any costly or irreversible step, the agent requests a typed second opinion (choice, score or boolean with probabilities); a shadow mode logs decisions without blocking. Includes a working terminal demo. Honest heads-up: experimental, 3 stars.
